gtfs.method_note: Re-check applies the pipeline's rule to the current MobilityData feed; untimed stop times are skipped (the pipeline interpolates them) and the stop centre is the Census polygon centroid (the pipeline uses the land-clipped centroid), so small differences mix schedule drift with method.

facilities.note: Reference point is the Census polygon's representative point (the pipeline's rule, without its water clipping). A charger opened since the build makes the bundle farther; one closed or delisted makes it nearer.

heat_definition.bundle: 2021 avg_temp (average temperature of the block group on a hot summer day) minus the mean avg_temp of the same county's block groups in its urbanized area (pipeline/sources_oc.py tes_by_bg)
heat_definition.current: temp_diff: difference between the block group's average heat extremity and the urban-area average (units not stated in the data dictionary)
